verdict.rationale: The product's own GitHub README lists "metadata filtering" as a shipped capability, so the core axis is first-party, but nothing documents the filter syntax, the supported structured conditions, or how filtering behaves. The general sub-10ms latency claims are not tied to filtered queries, so they cannot show filtering avoids hurting latency. missing for 10: documented filter syntax and operators (equality, range, boolean/compound conditions), evidence that recall holds under restrictive filters, latency figures for filtered queries, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency

citations.quote: Hybrid retrieval (semantic + Keyword Search), built-in embeddings, metadata filtering, and a WebAssembly build that runs in the browser
